notes: 1922 flats. Pale grey painted stucco, three storeys read off the street still (data says four), two storeys of paired sash windows, a railed steel fire escape on the front, bracketed cornice. Ground: round-arched gated entry left, small shopfront with glazed door right. Rework r-eddy: paired windows in two groups, green shop sign band, plain cornice. Storey count kept at 3. Tint lift (2026-10-02): paint tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k); brick tints converted to target / kit colour. Base fix (2026-10-03): cool/grey wallTint = target / painted-stucco base so the warm stucco albedo does not turn it pink. GroundBand lift (2026-10-03): groundBand tint #b8bcc0 -> #dcdee0 (same rule as walls; it was missed by the first colour pass).
